FIS Presentation Studio:
confident, repeatable digital demos

A desktop studio that gives every pre-sales consultant the same branded, up-to-date, client-ready demonstrations, centrally governed and fully usable offline. We built it in-house as a ready-to-run Plan B in case the trycoast.io programme does not proceed.

Why we built this

The challenge in pre-sales demos today

Digital content is our strongest proof of what we can design. But the way it reaches clients depends too much on each person.

Without a platform

  • Demos live on individual laptops, in different versions and states of branding.
  • No reliable way to know who has the latest content, or to push fixes.
  • Live environments and connectivity fail at the worst moment.
  • Personalising a demo for a client means manual edits, every time.
  • No view of which demos are used, for which clients or opportunities.

With FIS Presentation Studio

  • One governed catalogue, versioned and fingerprinted, with the same experience every time.
  • New versions are detected at start-up and installed with one click.
  • Demos run from a local cache, so they work without network, VPN or a live system.
  • Personas and data sets tailor the story to the client in seconds.
  • Opt-in tracking ties sessions to client name and opportunity ID.
Strategic context

A Plan B for trycoast.io, and more than a workaround

trycoast.io is a SaaS digital presentation platform for building and presenting product demos and presentations. It remains a strong option. However, its funding depends on cross-charging, and senior line-of-business leaders have so far been reluctant to fund it from their own budgets. If that is not resolved, pre-sales would be left with no platform at all.

Plan B

Ready if Coast falls through

A working, in-house alternative that can be rolled out now with little effort and cost, so momentum on digital demos is not lost while funding is decided.

Complementary

Offline companion to Coast

Even if Coast proceeds, this studio covers what a SaaS tool cannot: guaranteed offline delivery from the consultant's laptop, with FIS-owned assets.

Bridge

Coast → offline conversion

The studio can become the route to convert Coast-built demos into offline FIS packages, giving a fallback copy of every key demo (subject to Coast's export options and licence terms).

Our recommendation

Keep FIS Presentation Studio ready as Plan B, at minimal cost, while the Coast funding decision is made. If Coast goes ahead, keep the studio as the offline and FIS-owned companion and as a conversion path for critical Coast demos. If Coast does not proceed, scale the studio by moving the repository to an FIS-hosted endpoint and growing the demo catalogue.

Product tour

A day in the life of a consultant

From opening the app to presenting a personalised demo, using real screens from the current build. Click any screenshot to enlarge it.

01

Healthy before the first click

Every launch runs a quick set of health checks — repository connection, demo updates, runtime and storage — so a consultant knows the tool is ready before they are in front of a client.

02

A branded front door

A consistent FIS-branded home, with the consultant's identity, repository status and pending updates always visible in the sidebar.

03

My solutions, first

Every demo is tagged to the FIS organisation (L3 business down to the L8 solution). The consultant opens straight onto the demos for the solutions they are assigned to, and can widen to the full catalogue with one click.

04

A curated, consistent library

Clean tiles with a branded banner, short description, version and last-updated date. Search, business filter and favourites make the right demo easy to find.

05

Know what you are about to show

Details show the organisation path, functions, and the personas and data sets the demo can be run with.

06

Tailored to the client in seconds

Before presenting, the consultant picks a persona and data set, enters the client name and opportunity ID, and chooses whether the session is tracked. The demo personalises itself — "Prepared for Northwind Bank".

07

Present with confidence — online or offline

The demo runs from the laptop's local cache in a dedicated player with a guided menu, next/previous navigation and full-screen mode. No network, no VPN, no surprises.

08

Always current, never guessing

Downloads shows what is published in the central repository, what is installed and what is assigned. New versions are offered at start-up and installed with one click.

09

Simple, safe management

Each tile has a menu to edit, view details or uninstall (with a typed confirmation, to prevent accidents).

10

Edit without a developer

The configuration editor manages names, descriptions, organisation tags, branding and tile colour theme. Changes update the library immediately, or can be saved as a brand-new demo.

11

One demo, many stories

Data sets let the same demo tell a Tier 1 bank, regional broker or asset manager story. Each is validated for structure and size before it can be used.

12

Governed and supportable

Settings cover storage, backups, repository, display and tracking. Built-in logs and an About panel give support teams what they need without remote access.

13

Transparent at a glance

The About panel summarises versions, installed demos, tracked sessions and repository status for this PC.

How it works

Central repository, local cache

Content is published once to a central repository. Each consultant's studio keeps a verified local copy, so demos are governed centrally but delivered locally, with no dependency on the network during a client meeting.

PublishAuthors package a new version with release notes into the repository.
CheckAt start-up the studio compares local versions with the repository.
Prompt"An update is available — install now?" One click: Yes.
Verify & cacheThe package is fingerprint-checked, installed and the old version retired.
Present offlineDemos launch from the local cache, and usage syncs when back online.
Next steps

From working build to rollout

1 · Decide position

Confirm the Plan B / companion role alongside the trycoast.io funding decision.

2 · Host the repository

Move from the pilot shared folder to an FIS-hosted, access-controlled endpoint.

3 · Pilot group

Roll out to a small pre-sales cohort, and maintain assignments by L8 solution.

4 · Grow the catalogue

Build further demos with AI-assisted authoring, within an agreed internal AI budget.

5 · Coast conversion

If Coast proceeds, test exporting Coast demos into offline FIS packages.

6 · Measure impact

Report demo usage by business, solution and opportunity from tracked sessions.
